October brings an emphasis on your work, wellness, and partnerships, dear Taurus, as well as a retrograde of your ruling planet, Venus. These influences aren't necessarily about a lack of confidence, but about recognizing the need to look within for answers. Questioning your plans is likely and perhaps necessary.

Some disconnects in the love department are possible with Venus retrograde from October 3rd to November 13th. Mercury turns retrograde on the 24th. Values, goals, or ambitions can sometimes clash, serving up some tension or frustration. Others may misinterpret your intentions, or you theirs, and people seem more competitive than cooperative at times. There can be some unrest or emotional fireworks to manage, especially around the 10th and 30th. You may be dealing with impatience or bad timing in your interactions. Save important ideas or topics for a more free-spirited time, but pay attention to problem areas, especially if they keep resurfacing.

You gravitate toward seeking more fun and enjoyment in your life in October, dear Gemini. There can be a stronger focus on creative projects and leisure time, but work, routine, and health matters are strongly on your mind. Both your sectors of play and work are strong, with the latter increasing further as the month advances.

Venus is retrograde from the 3rd onward, and it will continue until November 13th. In your work and health sector during the first three weeks of the retrograde, you may experience slowdowns in projects or waiting games around health or your job. These matters will clear up starting in mid-November and require you to be patient and understanding. Looking back at old jobs, projects, and even co-workers can be a tendency and may benefit you. Going over past errors or problems is likely, especially with work, chores, wellness, and, from the 25th forward, romance and entertainment.

Certainly, projects may stall or could need review. Some things may feel a little hollow to you now, prompting some re-examination. Even so, this review is necessary and can lead to some very happy improvements, eventually! If you can swing it, working independently or setting your own pace may be better, since the social climate is a little chilly for now. October is a strong month for spiritual healing, home and family, and creative expression, dear Cancer. Focus on fixing problems and redesigning or organizing rather than new projects.

More opportunities to enjoy recreation and creative pastimes emerge this month, especially as October advances, and you’re likely to experiment with different entertainment formats. You’ll also attract an admirer or more, but keep in mind that with retrograde Venus, old flames have a way of reappearing, or that’s where you’re focused. Review the past but also aim to put it behind you for the best results.

All in all, you can be quite focused on your personal life this month. You’re certainly motivated to improve your domestic or inner world, and feeling more secure is part of this. In fact, you have lovely energy with you for building, improving, and developing any work-in-progress. You might thoroughly enjoy developing something that has long-term potential.

Close personal relationships, sharing, and learning are in the spotlight in October, dear Pisces. You may be in a rather introspective phase, often turning inward for answers while also making astute observations as you step back from the action a little. This is not to say you’re inactive – in fact, you’re particularly busy this month – but that you’re conserving some of your energy for plans and strategies.
